$comment: Committed on purpose. This is what makes the plugin available, and current, in any
session opened on this repository - including cloud and web sessions, which never see
~/.claude and so cannot inherit anything installed on a laptop.
Claude Code reads extraKnownMarketplaces from every settings source and installs the
enabled plugins at session start, so a cloud session always gets the newest commit.
autoUpdate is the per-MARKETPLACE switch. It defaults to true only for claude.ai-hosted
marketplaces and a hard-coded allowlist of official Anthropic ones; every third-party
GitHub marketplace, this one included, defaults to OFF. With it on, Claude Code refreshes
the marketplace and updates its installed plugins in the background shortly after a
Copy this block into any other project's .claude/settings.json to get the same there.
